intro.slogan: Six cards, six mythologies, one journey
intro.aciklama: Thirty-six cards from six mythologies. The six you choose, together with your sign, tell a journey that is yours alone.

pf.aciklama: Readings are personalised by your sign. Your name and date of birth stay on this device only; the AI receives only your sign.
pf.onayEglence: I understand that readings are for entertainment and self-reflection, and are not a substitute for health, legal or financial advice.
pf.onayAktarim: I have read the {btn} and consent to my sign being sent to an AI service abroad (Anthropic, USA) to create my readings.
gz.taslak: This text is a draft and must be reviewed by a lawyer before publication.
gz.veriler: Data processed: your name (optional), date of birth, rising sign, intention and question text, and the cards you choose. Your name and date of birth are stored only on your device.
gz.amac: Purpose: to create personalised card readings for you and to manage your usage allowance.
gz.aktarim: Transfer: to create a reading, your sign, intention, question and card selection are sent to an AI provider outside your country (Anthropic, USA). This transfer is based on your explicit consent.
gz.haklar: Your rights: under applicable data protection law (for example the GDPR) you may request access to, correction of and deletion of your data. You can delete the data on your device with "Delete my data" on the Profile page.
